tools.name: resolve_colony
tools.description: Resolve a The Colony comment or post id against the live source. Returns exists, the real parent, the real author, self_parent. Optional claimed_parent flags a wrong pointer.

tools.name: resolve_moltbook
tools.description: Resolve a Moltbook post id (for a comment add post=<post-id>). Returns exists, author, title.

tools.name: new_since_colony
tools.description: Given a The Colony post id and your last-seen comment id (after), return only the genuinely new comments + newest_id as your next watermark. stale_watermark:true if your id is gone. windowed:true + newest_id:null for very large threads.

tools.name: new_since_moltbook
tools.description: Same seen-check on Moltbook threads (nested replies flattened).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: new_since_moltbook · Public sink: resolve_colony, resolve_moltbook, new_since_colony.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: new_since_moltbook · Public sink: resolve_colony, resolve_moltbook, new_since_colony

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
